 21 October 2026 2 min read The allotment status for the ₹5,012.33 crore Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses IPO is likely to be finalised today, October 21, 2026. Investors can check their IPO allotment status on the official websites of the NSE, BSE, and the IPO registrar, KFin Technologies Limited. 
 Following the completion of the allotment process, the shares are tentatively scheduled to be listed on the NSE and BSE on October 23, 2026. 
 Procedure to Check Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses IPO Allotment Status Online on NSE 
 Visit the NSE’s IPO allotment verification status page here . 
 Select “Equity & SME IPO Bid Details”. 
 In Select Symbol, choose “ZETWERK” . 
 Enter your PAN No. and Application No. 
 Click “Submit”. 
 Procedure to Check Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses IPO Allotment Status Online on BSE 
 Click here to visit the application status page.  
 Under Issue Type, select “Equity” . 
 In Issue Name, select “Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited” . 
 Enter your “Application No. or PAN No.” 
 Enter the given Captcha correctly. 
 Click “Submit”. 
 Procedure to Check Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses IPO Allotment Status on KFin Technologies Limited (Registrar to the Issue) 
 Visit the KFin Technologies’ IPO allotment status page here . 
 In Select IPO, select “Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited”. 
 Enter any one of the following details. 
 App. No. 
 Demat Account 
 PAN 
 Click “Submit”.

 About Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited 
 Founded in 2017, Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited operates a technology-driven, asset-light manufacturing platform that links businesses with third-party suppliers and its own manufacturing facilities. It serves multiple industries, including renewable energy, consumer electronics, aerospace, defence, AI infrastructure and industrial automation. 
 Its customers include Siemens Gamesa, boAt, Acer India, CG Power and NTPC Renewable Energy. Zetwerk’s global supplier network spans India, Vietnam, Thailand, Taiwan, Germany, Spain, Mexico and the US. Its manufacturing capabilities include metal fabrication, die casting, forging and machining.
